objective: Close Phase 9 item C25: the tasks of odd/tasks/phase9-c25-review-hunt.md, so that our own review beats gentle-ai's native review on recall of real defects at no higher cost on a corpus of about 25 real cases, or gentle-ai review is re-enabled.
scope: The specs S1-S6 of odd/tasks/phase9-c25-review-hunt.md; one workflow and one role chain for each task.
constraints: The builder builds only a task the shaper designed.
The acceptance bar and gentle-ai's numbers are written in the Log before T3 starts and are not changed after (S1).
Gentle-ai and our review are scored by the same rule on the same real cases, with prompt bytes from the same shim (S2).
Nothing reaches the role chain before T7 records that the bar is met (S6).
Every commit is reviewed or exempted, and labdrian review check clears it.
non_goals: Changing the codex or pi paths of review launch beyond the refusal text of an unknown runtime.
Removing the risk-line row id or rewriting roles/reviewer/body.md.
Retuning the hunt lens on the scores of T7.
Re-enabling gentle-ai review on the owner's behalf.
acceptance_criteria: T1-T8 of odd/tasks/phase9-c25-review-hunt.md are checked off, each with its commit or, for the not-met outcome, the owner's recorded run.
The Log holds the bar entry of T1 before the first T3 commit and the verdict entry of T7 against exactly those numbers.
labdrian review check --onto main clears the head of each task's pull request.
runtime_scope: Claude Code, as the parent that runs the labdrian workflow and the role agents.
delivery_boundary: Work-unit commits on the branches of odd/tasks/phase9-c25-review-hunt.md; push, pull requests, merges and re-enabling gentle-ai review are the owner's decisions.
